parts.text:
If you are trying to log in to your Microsoft account, you can access the official login page using the links below:

*   **Direct Login Page:** [Microsoft Account Sign-In (login.live.com)](https://login.live.com/)
*   **Account Homepage:** [Microsoft Account Dashboard (account.microsoft.com)](https://account.microsoft.com/)

---

### **What is this account used for?**
A single Microsoft account gives you access to all Microsoft products and services, including:
*   **Email:** Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live, and MSN.
*   **Gaming:** Xbox Live and Xbox Game Pass.
*   **Storage & Productivity:** OneDrive, Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and Skype.
*   **Operating Systems:** Windows 10 and Windows 11.

---

### **Having trouble signing in?**
*   **Forgot your password?** Click **"Forgot password?"** on the login screen or go directly to the [Microsoft Password Reset Page](https://account.live.com/ResetPassword.aspx).
*   **Locked out of your account?** If your account has been temporarily locked due to unusual activity, you can request a security code sent to your registered phone number or recovery email to unlock it.
*   **Account Recovery:** If you don't have access to your recovery email or phone number, you can fill out the [Microsoft Account Recovery Form](https://account.live.com/acsr).

⚠️ **Security Tip:** Always ensure that the address bar in your web browser displays **`https://login.live.com/`** or **`https://login.microsoftonline.com/`** before entering your credentials to protect your account from phishing websites.
